summary: The main article describes a Ni/photoredox-catalyzed C(sp3)-C(sp3) coupling between aziridines and acetals, supported by 2 tables for optimization and scope, 8 schemes for mechanistic studies and pathways, and 1 figure illustrating the general concept. The document provides extensive mechanistic evidence for a Ni(I)-Ni(III) oxidative addition pathway.

items.heading: Figure 1
items.caption: Cross-electrophile and redox-neutral metallaphotoredox coupling with C(sp 3 ) precursors.
items.description: This figure compares traditional cross-electrophile coupling with the current work's redox-neutral metallaphotoredox approach using aziridines and acetals.

items.heading: Table 1
items.caption: Optimization of aziridine alkylation with benzaldehyde dialkyl acetals.
items.description: This table details the screening of reaction conditions including nickel source, light intensity, and temperature to optimize the yield of product 3a.

items.heading: Table 2
items.caption: Reaction substrate scope with aziridines and benzaldehyde dialkyl acetals.
items.description: This table demonstrates the substrate scope for various styrenyl aziridines and different alkyl groups derived from acetals.

items.heading: Scheme 1
items.caption: Alkylation of aziridine via direct incorporation of C(sp 3 )-H substrates
items.description: Shows the direct C(sp3)-H alkylation of aziridines using toluene and THF as reagents.

items.heading: Scheme 2
items.caption: Possible mechanistic pathways for accessing Ni(III) to enable product formation.
items.description: Outlines four potential mechanistic pathways involving different nickel oxidation states and intermediates.

items.heading: Scheme 3
items.caption: Crossover experiment and stoichiometric studies with azametallacycle IIa .
items.description: Details crossover experiments and stoichiometric reactivity of the Ni(II) azametallacycle to rule out certain pathways.

items.heading: Scheme 4
items.caption: Reactivity of benzyl bromide 7a .
items.description: Investigates the role of in situ generated benzyl bromide in the reaction mechanism.

items.heading: Scheme 5
items.caption: Stoichiometric studies with Ni(I) complex.
items.description: Presents stoichiometric evidence for the oxidative addition of aziridines to a Ni(I) alkyl complex.

items.heading: Scheme 6
items.caption: Alkylation of enantioenriched aziridine.
items.description: Shows the reaction of an enantioenriched aziridine resulting in a racemic product, suggesting a stereoablative process.

items.heading: Scheme 7
items.caption: Hammett plot analysis .
items.description: Displays Hammett plots used to analyze the electronic effects of substituents on the aziridine activation rate.

items.heading: Scheme 8
items.caption: Proposed mechanistic pathway and off-cycle pathways.
items.description: Illustrates the full proposed catalytic cycle including the photoredox and nickel cycles, as well as off-cycle degradation pathways.
